stories.title: Après les polémiques, le succès très tranquille de l'équipe de Suisse en Macédoine du Nord

en.title: After controversies, Switzerland's team enjoys smooth success in North Macedonia
en.summary: Switzerland's football team defeated North Macedonia 3-0 in their Nations League opener despite missing four regular players and controversy surrounding false COVID certificates. The team topped their group in League B.

stories.title: Ligue des nations - La Suisse fait le job en Macédoine du Nord notamment grâce à un excellent Zeki Amdouni

en.title: Nations League - Switzerland does the job in North Macedonia notably thanks to an excellent Zeki Amdouni
en.summary: Switzerland started their Nations League campaign with a 3-0 victory over North Macedonia in Skopje. Striker Zeki Amdouni scored twice and provided an assist in the convincing performance.

stories.title: Plusieurs milliers de personnes manifestent à Berne en faveur de l’asile et des migrants

en.title: Several thousand people demonstrate in Bern in favor of asylum and migrants
en.summary: Thousands of people protested in Bern organized by asylum and migration advocates, opposing stricter asylum legislation and opposing measures affecting non-Swiss passport holders. The demonstration targeted the federal asylum strategy for 2027 and a UDC border protection initiative.

stories.title: Nach Xis Besuch in den USA – China und USA richten KI-Kommunikationskanal ein

en.title: Following Xi's visit to the USA - China and USA establish AI communications channel
en.summary: China and the United States have established a regular dialogue channel to discuss risks and benefits associated with artificial intelligence technology.

stories.title: «Léon nous apporte de la joie»: sur les Champs-Elysées, le pape célèbre la messe devant quelque 800 000 fidèles

en.title: "Leon brings us joy": on the Champs-Elysées, the pope celebrates mass before approximately 800,000 faithful
en.summary: Pope Leon XIV celebrated mass on the Champs-Elysées in Paris, attracting hundreds of thousands of worshippers from across France and worldwide. The gathering drew larger crowds than the 2024 Olympic opening ceremony.

stories.title: LIVE-TICKER - Iran-Krieg: Trump lehnt iranisches Hormuz-Angebot ab +++ Saudiarabien meldet erneuten Luftangriff der Huthi-Miliz

en.title: LIVE TICKER - Iran War: Trump rejects Iranian Hormuz offer +++ Saudi Arabia reports renewed Houthi militia air attack
en.summary: The United States and Iran have been in a state of war since February 2026, with a ceasefire that Trump declared ended in early July. The ticker reports ongoing developments in the conflict.

stories.title: Le Parti socialiste vaudois lance ses trois candidats pour le Conseil d'Etat

en.title: The Vaud Socialist Party launches its three candidates for the State Council
en.summary: Roger Nordmann, Jessica Jaccoud and Samuel Bendahan were officially nominated by the Vaud Socialist Party for the State Council elections scheduled for February and March.

stories.title: Des milliers de personnes ont manifesté à Berne pour l'asile et les migrants

en.title: Thousands of people demonstrated in Berne for asylum and migrants
en.summary: Several thousand people rallied in Berne on Saturday to protest the tightening of asylum legislation and the exclusion of non-Swiss passport holders from certain protections.

stories.title: Les socialistes vaudois investissent Roger Nordmann, Jessica Jaccoud et Samuel Bendahan pour l’élection au Conseil d’Etat

en.title: Vaud socialists nominate Roger Nordmann, Jessica Jaccoud and Samuel Bendahan for State Council election
en.summary: The Vaud Socialist Party designated three candidates by acclamation at an extraordinary congress for the upcoming State Council elections in February and March, with no other socialist nominees.

stories.title: DIE NEUESTEN ENTWICKLUNGEN - Sicherheit von KI: USA und China richten Kommunikationskanal ein für KI-Notfälle – und nennen KI neu «Superintelligenz»

en.title: Latest Developments - AI Safety: USA and China Establish Communication Channel for AI Emergencies – and Rename AI as "Superintelligence"
en.summary: The United States and China have set up a communications channel to handle potential artificial intelligence emergencies. Leading figures from major AI companies are advocating for slowing AI development due to their concerns.

stories.title: Après la messe géante qui a rassemblé 800'000 fidèles à Paris, le pape Léon XIV arrive à Lourdes

en.title: After the Giant Mass That Gathered 800,000 Faithful in Paris, Pope Leo XIV Arrives in Lourdes
en.summary: Pope Leo XIV continued his France visit in Lourdes following a large gathering in Paris where approximately 800,000 people attended a mass at Place de la Concorde.

stories.title: Krieg im Nahen Osten – Trump lehnt den vom Iran vorgelegten Friedensplan ab

en.title: War in the Middle East – Trump Rejects Peace Plan Presented by Iran
en.summary: The US President declined to accept Iran's proposal for ending hostilities in the Middle East conflict.

stories.title: Putins Günstlinge sprechen bereits in Nestlés Namen: Dem Schweizer Konzern droht in Russland das Danone-Drehbuch

en.title: Putin's Associates Already Speaking in Nestlé's Name: Swiss Conglomerate Faces Russia Scenario Similar to Danone
en.summary: Nestlé lost control of its Russian subsidiary following a government-ordered forced administration by Vladimir Putin's regime. The company is seeking Swiss government assistance to prevent further deterioration.

stories.title: Der Fall Sunrise lässt aufhorchen: Erfasst die KI-Entlassungswelle die Grosskonzerne?

en.title: The Sunrise case raises concerns: Is the AI layoff wave reaching large corporations?
en.summary: A telecommunications company is making significant workforce reductions. Experts worry this approach may spread to banks and insurance firms.

stories.title: Nach der Schlappe im Ständerat: Das UBS-Lager plant einen neuen Kompromiss – die Börse wettet auf einen Wegzug

en.title: Following the setback in the Council of States: The UBS camp plans a new compromise – the stock market bets on relocation
en.summary: Conservative members of the National Council are pursuing another attempt in a dispute over capital requirements for a major bank. Stock markets are anticipating a possible departure.

stories.title: Verschärfung der Lex Koller: Schweizer Pensionskassen könnten Milliarden verlieren

en.title: Tightening of Lex Koller: Swiss pension funds could lose billions
en.summary: The National Council aims to restrict foreign investor access to the Swiss real estate market more severely, including real estate stocks and funds. The changes could significantly impact pension funds and private investors.

stories.title: Exklusive Daten zeigen: Die Klage über die Prämienlast ist übertrieben

en.title: Exclusive data show: Complaints about premium burden are exaggerated
en.summary: Swiss health insurance premiums rise annually, but new data indicate the financial burden remains manageable for households across all income levels.
